name: mangadl
description: Desktop manga/manhwa reader and resilient downloader.
author: Gun Kaewngarm <aongoong.gk@gmail.com>

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @mangadl/core && npm run build -w @mangadl/sources && npm run build -w @mangadl/persistence && npm run build -w @mangadl/downloader
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @mangadl/desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/sources packages/persistence packages/downloader apps/desktop/tsconfig.main.json apps/desktop/tsconfig.renderer.json
scripts.package:prepare: npm run build && node ./scripts/prepare-electron-package.mjs && npm install --prefix release/stage --omit=dev --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund && node ./scripts/vendor-electron-workspaces.mjs
scripts.package:dir: npm run package:prepare && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --projectDir release/stage --dir
scripts.package:win: npm run package:prepare && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --projectDir release/stage --win
scripts.publish:github: npm run package:prepare && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --projectDir release/stage --win --publish always
